svg.title: ISR — A framework for collective decision-making
svg.desc: A framework for collective decision-making through deliberation and weighted voting. Mission: help communities turn shared concerns into informed, inclusive decisions. The illustrated flow leads from raising an issue, to gathering affected people, deliberation, weighted voting, and collective action. A research prototype using synthetic data. Visit https://isr-vote.com.
